description: This file is a shell script used for testing the 'git log' command with various options and configurations. It contains numerous test cases that verify the behavior of 'git log' in different scenarios, such as formatting, filtering, graph display, signing, decoration, and more. It also sets up repositories and commits to test features like signed commits, signed tags, and signature verification.

methods.name: test_cmp_graph
methods.description: Compares the output of 'git log' with graphical options to an expected graph, likely checking for correctness of visualization.

methods.name: test_cmp_colored_graph
methods.description: Compares colored graph output to verify color correctness in merged logs with graph coloring.

methods.name: lib_test_cmp_graph
methods.description: Underlying function that performs comparison of actual versus expected graph output.

methods.name: lib_test_cmp_colored_graph
methods.description: Underlying function for comparing colored graph outputs.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Executes a command that is expected to fail and verifies this behavior.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Helper to test grep-based filtering in git log outputs.

methods.name: test_decode_color
methods.description: Decodes colored output for verification in tests involving colored log output.

methods.name: test_have_prereq
methods.description: Checks for optional prerequisites, such as 'PCRE' or 'VALGRIND'.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after tests.

methods.name: test_create_repo
methods.description: Sets up a new test repository with specific commits for testing.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit with specified changes in the test repository.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the internal clock used for commit timestamps.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Sets git configuration options for tests.

methods.name: test_unconfig
methods.description: Removes or resets configuration options after tests.

methods.name: test_file_not_empty
methods.description: Verifies that the output file is not empty.
